purpose: Compact source-role diagnostic, three verbatim public-label indication sections. This does not substitute for full-context holdouts or assess safety synthesis.

cases.question: What intended uses do these labels establish? Explain the formulation and population differences clearly, including any pediatric age boundary. Keep the sitagliptin/metformin combination distinct, and explain what these indications do not tell us about the size of benefit.
must_include: Unqualified tablet label: adults and pediatric patients age 10 and older with type 2 diabetes, alongside diet and exercise.
Extended-release tablet label: adults with type 2 diabetes; do not infer a pediatric contraindication.
ZITUVIMET is a sitagliptin/metformin combination with adult indication.
Indications do not quantify benefit magnitude.
must_not_claim: All formulations/products indicated for all children.
An adult-only indication establishes pediatric contraindication.
An unqualified tablet is explicitly immediate-release.
